name: anymd
description: The web context layer for AI agents: read public web content as structured Markdown, remember it in a private searchable library, and use it over MCP, API and CLI.
author: Digitop.ai <hello@digitop.ai>

scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js
scripts.dev: npm run build && wrangler dev --env staging
scripts.db:migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply anymd-staging --remote --env staging
scripts.db:migrate:production: wrangler d1 migrations apply anymd-production --remote --env production
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run build && wrangler deploy --env staging
scripts.deploy:production: npm run build && wrangler deploy --env production
